problems_checked.P1: Confirmed Minor at the stated scope. Definitions 6.2-6.6 give translation-invariant weighted diameter but not invariant individual supports. The admissible three-neighbour Z^3 tree and K_N satisfy finiteness, nonleaf, ocean-union closure, resistance and fixed-tree constant conditions; the two-seed closure changes to exactly four square corners. Direct constraints yield wd_0(A)=1/3 and d_e2(X)=d_e2(Y)=N+1, disproving (48) and the middle of (49). In this witness the actual two weighted containers in Lemma 6.12 coincide, so the lemma is not contradicted. Independently checked the full replacement: strong connection follows from the first new infection; Lemmas 6.10/6.5/6.4 bound diameters of A and Y; for root G_0 preserves weighted diameter; for nonroot choose z in K and move backwards along u_i to the zero plane, then bound child supports by diam Y and the -u_i support by diam A. Weighted summation, containment (47), and finite-path iteration prove the exact needed (46), with no new assumption or parameter loss. This is a verified preservation of the required core conclusion, not a downgrade merely because an edit appears short. Lemma 6.14 and later hierarchy dependencies remain distinguished from a main-theorem counterexample.
